ED Takes Action Against HashPe Crypto Ponzi Scheme, Attaches INR 4 Crore Assets
items.snippet: The ED has provisionally attached assets worth around INR 14.2 crore in the HashPe cryptocurrency Ponzi fraud case under the PMLA, 2002. The agency said HashPe allegedly misled investors with promises of a 1% daily return, referral commissions and cryptocurrency earnings.

items.title: India Bans Battery Black Mass Exports to Promote Domestic Lithium-Ion Recycling
items.snippet: India has banned export of black mass of lithium-ion batteries to boost domestic recycling and recovery of essential minerals. The DGFT wants to provide a consistent supply of battery debris to local recyclers and refiners to recover important minerals.

items.title: Kunal Shah Highlights Three Growth Priorities for WhatsApp: AI, Finance and Connectivity
items.snippet: WhatsApp CEO Kunal Shah has highlighted three major development targets for the messaging company, including artificial intelligence (AI), financial services and better connectivity. The Meta-owned app wants to go beyond communications by streamlining bill payments, financial activities and more.

items.title: IBM Restricts H-1B Visa and Green Card Sponsorship Across Consulting Workforce
items.snippet: IBM has chosen to stop sponsoring H-1B visas and Green Cards for most jobs in its Consulting arm, impacting a workforce of over 150,000. The action comes amid heightened scrutiny of U.S. immigration and employment visa programs by the Trump administration.
